event.distribution_pattern: Distribution centers and retail locations across the U.S.

products.product_description: Rocky Road Ice Cream packaged in a Breyer Chocolate Truffle Tub that says "may contain tree nuts" with a Breyers Rocky Road Ice Cream Lid that declares almonds as an ingredient. 1.5 qt
products.product_quantity: 6668 cases (roughly 12 individual units believed to be affected)
products.reason_for_recall: Undeclared allergens and mislabeled product. Rocky Road Ice was packaged with Chocolate Truffle Ice Cream labeled tub and a Rocky Road Ice Cream lid. Tub said "may contain tree nuts" the lid said it did contain almonds.
